name: Password Change Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers integration proof that the real authentication flow entry point, flow handler, PasswordManager and LagoVista Identity adapter execute the canonical password-change success and failure paths.
notes: The tests do not mock AuthenticationFlowService, PasswordChangeFlowHandler, PasswordManager or the LagoVista Identity UserManager adapter.
Only dependencies below the LagoVista Identity adapter, including Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.UserManager<AppUser>, are mocked.
AptixEvidence and AptixAuthEvents properties allow the test builder to emit machine-readable run evidence under .aptix/evidence.

sourceReferences.note: Canonical integration evidence source for both password-change outcomes.
Extracts AptixEvidence metadata from the compiled test assembly for runtime evidence generation.
